description: Find MCP servers by name, description or use case. Returns publisher metadata and pagination; use get_mcp_server for connection details. Does not connect or execute third-party tools.

limit.description: How many servers to return (1-50). Ten is usually enough to choose from; raise it only when scanning a crowded category.

offset.description: Where to start in the result list. Pass the nextOffset from the previous response to page through more matches.

query.description: Words that must ALL appear in a server's name, title or description — for example 'github issues' or 'postgres'. This is literal matching, not semantic: try the product name first, then a capability word. Empty browses everything.

transport.description: 'remote' = hosted servers the user connects to by URL (no install). 'local' = packages the user runs on their own machine. 'all' = both. Choose 'remote' when the user cannot install software.

name: search_mcp_servers
